messages:
elaine: Hey folks, noticing a weird p99-only spike on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate in us-west-2 around ~11:02. p50/p95 look nominal.
raj: I pulled a quick slice — p99 jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.2s but p95 stayed ~220ms. Sounds like a tiny cohort dragging the tail.
casey: Any recent routing or quota changes this morning? @tess did we touch fallback weights or routing policies?
tess: I did a quick experiment — bumped fallback weight to the cheaper-variant to 30% at ~10:45 to test cost/perf, rolled it back at 10:55 after seeing a few errors :grimacing:
elaine: Timeline fits. Dashboard endpoint breakdown shows the p99 rise scoped to samples tagged route=dedicated. p95 for that tag is steady.
raj: If it's only one route, could be sampling/tagging drift or retries being ingested as separate samples (amplifying tail). Can we get raw counts by route?
casey: Running a raw query now, rough SQL-like:\n```\nSELECT minute_bucket(ts, 60) AS m, count(*) AS cnt, pctl(0.99, latency) AS p99\nFROM request_traces\nWHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='us-west-2' AND ts >= 1763120000\nGROUP BY m, route\nORDER BY m DESC\nLIMIT 60;\n```\ncasey: result: route=dedicated shows sporadic tiny spikes in count with huge p99; other routes stable.
tess: infra-bot: rollback for r-routing-policy completed at 10:56 (deploy id r-2026-03-15-0812)
infra-bot: deploybot: rollback acknowledged, all shards green
elaine: Interesting — also noticed a lot of those samples lack the `kv_cache_hit` tag. Proxy might not be forwarding the `X-KV-Hit` header for the cheaper variant.
raj: Quick mitigation: add an ad-hoc dashboard filter to exclude retries (is_retry=true). If p99 drops a lot, that's a smoking gun.
casey: done — created a dashboard slice excluding `is_retry=true`. p99 for route=dedicated drops back near baseline when retries excluded.
tess: That implies the cheaper-variant is experiencing higher tail and upstream clients are retrying -> double-counting/ amplification.
elaine: Action items we should track:
- Add route+retry provenance to telemetry (so we can attribute retries without manual filters) — instrumentation change
- Harden rollout logic to avoid amplifying retries when fallback weight changes (limit parallelism / increase warmup)
- Add alert rule: p99 jumps > 2x while p95 < 1.2x baseline (to catch tail-only regressions)
raj: I'll file tickets: INF-2147 (telemetry: route+retry provenance) and MON-4589 (alert: p99-only delta). Adding dashboard annotation for today's rollback.
casey: I'll add a short note to the rollout runbook: ensure X-KV-Hit preserved through variant proxies + recommend canary weights < 10% for initial trial.
tess: I can coordinate a controlled canary tomorrow with lower weight and longer warmup window. Also will audit cheaper-variant for any proxy header drops.
elaine: Nice. Also a UX suggestion for Console: in endpoint breakdowns, show a tiny provenance badge if a high p99 is driven by retries or non-KV-hit samples — makes root-cause obvious.
raj: Good idea — MON-4590 for console UX suggestion.
casey: adding comments to INF-2147 referencing MON-4589 and MON-4590 so infra+console teams link context.
tess: thanks all. will report back after the canary.
elaine: :thumbsup: keep this thread updated if you see other anomalies.
